name: Spriglet
subtitle: A little quiet company
description:
Spriglet brings little desktop companions called spriglets to your Mac.

Meet Mallow, your first spriglet. Soft, lavender and a little curious, Mallow peeks beneath your Mac's notch, blinking and breathing while you work.

INTERACT DIRECTLY
Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home. A second touch gets a wave or a gentle swing. Release near its home to catch it, or farther away for gravity and a squishy landing.

QUIET BY DEFAULT
Mallow returns to its small peek after you move on. Transparent margins pass clicks through. Displays without a notch use an upper-right resting place. Reduce Motion keeps interactions still and returns releases directly home; Low Power Mode, display sleep and session changes are respected.

CONTROLS WITHIN REACH
The leaf in the menu bar opens Settings or quits Spriglet. In Settings, use Show Mallow, Animate Mallow or Bring Home to recover Mallow, and choose Launch at Login. Meet Mallow and Help are available from Spriglet’s native Help menu and offline Help panel. Hidden Mallow is recoverable through Settings opened from the leaf or by reopening Spriglet from Finder.

MAKE IT YOURS
Open Settings from the leaf menu. Choose character size, movement intensity and home display/location. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this Mac. Use Tab, Shift-Tab, arrows and Space in Settings. VoiceOver offers Invite with a wave, Swing, Stretch and Bring Home actions.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics or server connection. No screen capture or global keyboard monitoring. No plugins or assistant services.

Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.
promotionalText: Little desktop companions, a little quiet company. Meet Mallow, your first spriglet: soft, curious and at home on your Mac.
reviewNotes:
Spriglet is a native macOS desktop companion for Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. No login, demo account, payments, advertising, analytics, tracking, backend or third-party SDK is required. The app uses a sandboxed, transparent, nonactivating panel and a persistent leaf in the menu bar. It has no Dock icon.

FIRST LAUNCH
Meet Mallow shows five short demonstrations using the production character. Next, Back and step buttons browse them. Skip, Done, close or Escape dismiss; dismissal is saved locally. Replay from Spriglet’s native Help menu, offline Help panel or Mallow’s direct VoiceOver action. Reduce Motion shows stills.

KEYBOARD AND RECOVERY
Use Control-F8 (or Fn-Control-F8) to reach the leaf, then arrows and Return to choose Settings or Quit. In Settings, Tab and Shift-Tab visit enabled controls even with macOS keyboard navigation off; arrows choose popup values and Space operates buttons and checkboxes. When Spriglet is active, Command-comma opens Settings, Command-Shift-H brings Mallow home, Command-Shift-P pauses/resumes, Command-Shift-M shows/hides and Command-W closes the focused window. Recovery never requires dragging: open Settings from the leaf and choose Show Mallow or Bring Home, or reopen Spriglet from Finder. These restore a resting peek and preserve Pause.

CHARACTER AND ACCESSIBILITY
Hover to react, click to invite with a wave, touch again to swing, drag to pick up, then release near home to catch or away for a soft landing. Outside clicks return home. VoiceOver describes rest, invitation, held, catch-ready, moving, grounded and paused states. Custom actions offer Invite Mallow, Swing, Stretch, Bring Home, Pause/Resume, Hide, Settings, Meet Mallow and Help. Gesture actions are unavailable while paused. Reduce Motion preserves deliberate dragging and blinking, suppresses decorative travel, and returns every release directly home.

SETTINGS AND LIFECYCLE
Size, movement intensity and home display/location apply immediately and persist locally. A missing selected display falls back without erasing its choice. A display without a notch uses an upper-right home below the menu bar. Hide and Pause are session choices; sleep, screen lock and display changes preserve them. The panel never takes keyboard focus. Explicitly opening Settings activates its native window. Offline Help preserves focus in the current app.

LOGIN AND PRIVACY
Launch at Login is off for a new installation. Explicitly enable or disable it in Settings. SMAppService registers the main app; no helper is installed. The UI shows actual macOS state, pending approval and failures. If approval is required, choose Open Login Items Settings and allow Spriglet under General > Login Items & Extensions. Startup never registers automatically. Quitting preserves registration.

No Accessibility, screen recording, camera, microphone, location or tracking permission is requested. Outside mouse clicks are observed only to dismiss Mallow; their content is not read. No global keyboard events are monitored. Only local preferences and introduction dismissal are saved. The bundled privacy manifest declares app-owned UserDefaults and elapsed animation timing. Support and privacy URLs are public; Help also works offline.
